# partiteai_agent (Resource)

Agent resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `input_message_type` (String) Schema defining the structure of input messages the agent can process
- `model_complexity` (String) Defines the complexity of the model the agent uses.
- `name` (String) Resource name
- `task_instructions` (String) Detailed instructions that guide the agent's behavior and decision-making processes.

### Optional

- `client_tasks` (Attributes Set) Set of client task definitions associated with the agent, referenced by client task definition ID (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client_tasks))
- `description` (String) Resource description
- `identity` (String) A brief description of the agent's identity, such as its role or persona.
- `mcp_connections` (Attributes Set) List of MCP connections associated with the agent (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mcp_connections))
- `memory_interaction_profile_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the memory interaction profiles this agent holds. A profile decides what memory goes in the agent's prompt and which memory tools it can call.
- `particles` (Attributes Set) List of installed particles exposed to the agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--particles))
- `send_messages_to_user` (Boolean) Whether the agent should send messages to the user
- `send_thinking_to_user` (Boolean) Whether the agent should send 'thinking' messages to the user
- `skills` (Attributes Set) Set of skills the agent can load, referenced by skill ID. No two of them can declare the same name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skills))
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags for the resource (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated
- `version_created_at` (String) Timestamp when the current version was created
- `version_id` (String) Current version identifier of the agent
- `version_ordinal` (Number) Current version ordinal of the agent

<a id="nestedatt--client_tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `client_tasks`

Required:

- `id` (String) Client task definition identifier


<a id="nestedatt--mcp_connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mcp_connections`

Required:

- `filter_type` (String) Type of filter applied to the MCP connection. One of 'NONE', 'LIST', or 'PATTERN'.
- `id` (String) MCP connection identifier

Optional:

- `tool_name_pattern` (String) Pattern to match tool names associated with the MCP connection
- `tool_names` (List of String) List of tool names associated with the MCP connection


<a id="nestedatt--particles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `particles`

Required:

- `filter_type` (String) Tool filter type. One of 'NONE', 'LIST', or 'PATTERN'.
- `id` (String) Installed particle identifier

Optional:

- `tool_name_pattern` (String) Regex matched against tool names. Required when filter_type is PATTERN.
- `tool_names` (List of String) Tool names to expose. Required (and non-empty) when filter_type is LIST.


<a id="nestedatt--skills"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skills`

Required:

- `id` (String) Skill identifier

### Nested Schema for `tags`

Required:

- `name` (String) Tag name
- `value` (String) Tag value
